interpretation_workflow.before_final_answer: Submit all source facts used in the draft with unchanged calculation_reference and exact JSON Pointer paths. Include full event/role objects when context matters. Correct contradicted facts and verify the corrected draft; identify unverified facts.
interpretation_workflow.scope: Submitted source fields only; quote semantics, omitted facts and psychological interpretations are not checked.

quality.limitations: 结构和一致性检查通过，不等于独立证明算法正确，也不验证解释。

settings.composite: short-arc midpoints; composite cusps are midpoints of Placidus cusps
